title: Story premise ENT003: The Invisible Bench Audition
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: Please sit on the bench that is not there. Takeaway/theme: Shared reference points make coordination easier.
description: A mime wants to demonstrate a perfect imaginary bench, but each audience member imagines a different height and sits out of sync. The mime draws a visible baseline in chalk, everyone aligns their poses, and a passing janitor politely sweeps the entire imaginary bench away.
